description: Capture the raw SAY/SPEAK character span using the parser's canonical lex-entry length and source-position bytes, reusing dormant parser globals for the lifetime of the SAY action, and split natural question/exclamation punctuation cleanly

replacements.new:
<COND (<NOT <EQUAL? .WRD ,W?AGAIN ,W?G>>
		      <SETG P-NUMBER 0>)>
	       <PUT ,OOPS-TABLE ,O-END <>>)>
	<COND (<AND <G? ,P-LEN 1>
		    <OR <EQUAL? .WRD ,W?SAY>
			<EQUAL? .WRD ,W?SPEAK>>>
	       <SET SPTR <GETB ,P-LEXV <+ <* .PTR ,P-LEXELEN> 7>>>
	       <SET SPTR <+ .SPTR <GETB ,P-LEXV <+ <* .PTR ,P-LEXELEN> 6>>>>
	       <SET LPTR <+ .PTR <* <- ,P-LEN 1> ,P-LEXELEN>>>
	       <SET EPTR <+ <GETB ,P-LEXV <+ <* .LPTR ,P-LEXELEN> 7>>
			    <GETB ,P-LEXV <+ <* .LPTR ,P-LEXELEN> 6>>>>
	       <SETG P-ADVERB .SPTR>
	       <SETG P-NUMBER <- .EPTR .SPTR>>
	       <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 1>
	       <SETG P-LEN 1>)>
	<COND (<EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV .PTR> ,W?AGAIN ,W?G>
